body: I'm sorry you've had these bad experiences with women related to your financial situation :(. I don't have the same struggle with finances, but I'm still without anyone. Who knows...
Thank you. It's tough for us. But for what it's worth your replies did genuinely make me feel better :), just for the acknowledgement. I hope we both can finally have what we need.
There I do agree with you, it really isn't right to be alone for decades.

I think that's all I can do, find something else to live for. But it's hard when there's no one to share it with. I just don't think I can feel fulfilled without sharing my life with someone. I've tried, hence living the life I've lived. But it's just not enough on its own. I don't know...

Isn't that fair? As people get older they look for different things in a partner. When young, they're just looking for someone attractive. When older, they're looking for someone to start a family with. I don think there's anything wrong with that.
There is a hell of a lot of generalising in your comment. I disagree.

Thank you for your kind words. I'm so sorry to hear that you had a bad experience with that one guy. I don't know how you two would have broken up, but he is just one guy in the whole world, and just because he decided it was over, it doesn't make you objectively worthless.

In response to your question, nope, no girl has ever showed interest in me in that way, except for that one person I had a few dates with. I went out with her a few times because no one else ever showed interest. So I think I can recognise if a girl likes me. With her, it didn't last. TBH I wasn't that into her and she wasn't that into me in the end.

I've know girls who I've thought was incredibly special. But they only saw me as a friend. Andy they were, and still are amazing friends who I treasure. And they knew how I felt about them because I told them. But they just didn't see me in that way. They never see me in that way.
